inicio.titulo: Your safe Jarvis: INTELECTO v2 and caixa-do-agente
inicio.lead: One mistake or malicious text hidden on a website can be enough for AI to delete a folder or send your password somewhere else. Here, you’ll build an assistant with a lock, a vault, and approval. You’ll learn how to let agents work in a copy in the sandbox, then create a plan your way at the grocery store.
inicio.capa_alt: A calm desk with a computer, a safe, and the title Your Safe Jarvis.

numeros.t: visible decisions: run, ask, or refuse
copy to test before using the original

inicio.aulas_sub: Start with the demo. Telegram and the service are optional; only lessons 6 and 7 require Docker. In lesson 9, choose ingredients and download your plan as a .md file.

itens: You use AI in chat, open a terminal, and can copy commands.
You haven’t built an agent yet and want to understand each safeguard before using one.
The course was tested on Linux (Ubuntu). macOS support exists in the code, but hasn’t been tested live. On Windows, use WSL with Ubuntu; that hasn’t been tested live either.
The assistant remembers a fact in a later run and records decisions in the audit log.
The sandbox tests in a copy without .env or keys. You review the patch (the change file) and decide whether to apply it to the original.
At the grocery store, choose ingredients, download meu-assistente.md, and check what already exists and what still needs to be built.
